desc: Public samples 1 and 2 produce correct output (Yes/No).
Differential validator (exhaustive BFS-vs-key for small N, random BFS for N=13..16, no-op regime) reported PASS with no counterexample.
Manual spot-checks for small N show residue-key classes coincide with reachable classes.
Guard logic (X+Y>N, frozen S/T, no-move regime) verified exact, so guards only remove false positives.
Complexity check: O(N) time / O(N) memory is within limits for N=5×10^5.
Edge cases covered: X+Y>N, X==Y, all-0/all-1, S==T, differing counts, z<X or o<Y.
